bootstrap.cluster: calendar day (own days of each cohort x stratum population)

strata.neither: a drive with an undefined statistic belongs to neither stratum (M444 S15); PCL-1 protocol drives are held out

zoneDefinition.note: zones are sums of the drawn 10 km/h bins; the 0-10 km/h bin is not a zone; the top zone keeps the overflow bin (>= 130 km/h)

referenceMix.note: the ONE all-cohort KE-weighted reference SOC mix of M444 (owner decision (c)); identical for every stratum, cohort and bar

resolutionBracket.definition: b_nat = max over f of |v2(native) - v2(decimated f)| (pp, point values), per stratum and cell. Fast-polled: f in {2, 3}, native v2 table against the equal-weight stack of the f phase variants, all intervals (the M442 form). Slow-polled: f = 2 on the common-support variant (intervals eligible in both runs), mean of the two phases. Never borrowed across strata, cells or estimands; a cell without a computable difference shows no resolution bracket. A sensitivity on data already seen, never a gate.

harmonizedBracketReference.note: the M442 harmonized b understates the native shift (reference only)

b6Reference.note: the pre-registered cadence-invariance check B6 (fast-polled drives against their thinned version) FAILED; shown beside the display; the condition (2) of M441 Rev 2.2 is not discharged (M446 Rev 1.1 D1)

label: cadence-stratified native apparent battery-side KE recovery (assumed masses), resolution-conditional; fast-polled and slow-polled drives are not comparable; not a correction of the legacy values
reading: Native v2 apparent KE recovery (ratio of sums over engine-off deceleration intervals, assumed class masses, 300 rpm engine-off proxy) for each polling stratum separately. A level depends on the logger's sampling resolution; the resolution bracket b_nat is the largest change of the cell value when the drives of the stratum are thinned (fast-polled by 2 and 3, slow-polled by 2). The day-clustered interval, the assumed-mass range, the resolution bracket and the plateau convention range are separate and are never combined. The two strata differ in date, season and temperature and are not contrasted; the fast-versus-slow comparison of M442 (G2) is not testable and the paired-cadence protocol PCL-1 was not run. Observed uses the actual SOC mix; SOC-standardized uses one common reference mix over the stated common-support bands and adjusts for SOC composition only.
disclosures: engine off is the RPM <= 300 proxy; assumed class masses; the field name eff is a label for the apparent KE recovery ratio, not an efficiency
temperature, SOC, speed, demand, day, season and the polling stratum are confounded in the logged data; all values are unadjusted and descriptive
the cadence-invariance study B6 FAILED for the fast-polled stratum; the M442 gate G2 is not testable; PCL-1 was not run
the 0-10 km/h and >= 130 km/h speed bins are in the payload only (payloadOnly)
refresh: recomputed at every ingestion by the stage regen_v2 (per-drive cache; decimated variants d2p0 d2p1 d3p0 d3p1 d3p2 are extended for new drives)
